verdict.rationale: Trivy has an official MCP server plugin (trivy-mcp) that brings its scanning into VS Code and other MCP-enabled tools, with natural-language scanning. That lets a coding agent invoke Trivy's filesystem, secret and IaC misconfiguration scans on the code it generates. The scriptable CLI and community reports of easy automation support wiring it in before code lands. Missing for 10: documented pre-commit or merge-gating workflow for agent output, hands-on corroboration of the MCP integration, and analysis of source-code logic beyond dependencies, secrets and IaC.
